root_idea.summary: A root centered on striking or pecking something until an impression or sound is produced.
root_idea.development: The basic notion extends to pecking, piercing and hollowing, producing sounds, investigating as if probing into a matter, and naming hollows, tools, and instruments associated with these actions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the distinct Quranic noun نَقِير.
Displayed as the distinct Quranic noun نَاقُور.

senses.definition: To be sounded by striking or blowing in the trumpet, producing the eschatological blast.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranically attested in the passive construction فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ, referring to the blast sounded in the horn at the Resurrection.

senses.definition: The tiny hollow or spot on the back of a date stone.
senses.usage_conditions: This literal image supplies the basis of the Quranic expression for something vanishingly small.

senses.definition: The least or most negligible amount; even a tiny speck.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic expressions concerning not giving someone anything or not wronging someone even to the smallest degree.

senses.definition: A horn or trumpet blown for the Resurrection.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun denotes the eschatological horn in the expression فِي النَّاقُورِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To peck or pick up grain from scattered places, as a bird does with its beak.
To hit the butt or central part of a target with an arrow without the arrow passing through it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of the archer who makes such a hit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pick up food or another thing with the finger.
To strike, peck, or work a stone, millstone, or similar object with a pointed instrument, shaping or roughening it.
To engrave writing on stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often expressed with فِي and the material engraved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tap or strike the head, ear, lute, or tambourine with the finger.
To snap the fingers by striking the thumb against a finger and releasing it.
To make a tongue-clicking or smacking sound to urge a horse or other beast forward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is used with بِ and refers to the characteristic sound made with the tongue against the palate or place of articulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bore, perforate, hollow, or excavate a thing; also, of horses or torrents, to leave hollows in the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe either the action of making a cavity or the resulting hollows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To investigate, scrutinize, or inquire into a matter or report in order to learn it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction commonly takes عَنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To test an arrow or make it produce a sharp sound by turning it between the fingers or on the thumb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized construction concerning the sonorous quality of an arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To criticize, disparage, or backbite a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use is figurative, as though striking or leaving an impression on the person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To signal or call to someone with a tongue-clicking sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a vocal signaling use directed toward a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A selective summons in which some people are invited and others are left out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes singling people out for an invitation rather than calling the whole group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain, desist, leave, or relinquish someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes عَنْ; it may describe not leaving someone until he is destroyed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slight sound, especially the snap of the fingers; in a negative expression, anything at all.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The idiom is used in phrases such as not rewarding someone with even a snap of the fingers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slight sound used to set a horse in motion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This nominal sense refers to the sound made in urging a mount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small hollow or depression in the ground, especially one in which water from a torrent remains.
The hollow at the back of the neck or nape, where the brain ends.
The cavity or socket of the eye.
A bodily foramen or bony socket, including the perforation described in the hip region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence allows both a general bodily socket and a specifically hip-related foramen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where a bird lays its eggs.
Something bored, perforated, hollowed, or excavated, especially of stone or wood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a passive-result noun describing a hollowed object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hollowed piece or stump of wood, especially a palm trunk, used as a vessel for preparing fermented beverage; the beverage made in it may also bear the name.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the specialized vessel mentioned in traditional reports concerning fermented drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hollowed palm trunk with step-like footholds by which one ascends to upper chambers.
Origin, stock, or lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In كَرِيمُ النَّقِيرِ, it describes someone noble in origin, conceived as having been brought out from a probed stock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quantity of grain that a bird pecks or picks up.
The material left over from boring or excavating stones.
An engraver, especially one who engraves stirrups and bits; also one who bores millstones.
A person who investigates, scrutinizes, or examines affairs and reports.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the agent noun in the figurative investigative branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow that hits the butt or eye of a target.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the plural idiom أَخْطَأَتْ نَوَاقِرُهُ, arrows that formerly hit the mark figuratively express failing to continue in the right course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or blow of fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural نَوَاقِرُ is used for calamities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sound argument, decisive evidence, or speech that hits its mark.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is figurative, based on an arrow striking the target.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having sunken or deeply recessed eyes.
The beak of a bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is distinguished from مِنْسَر, used for the beak of a bird of prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forepart of a camel’s foot.
A slender pointed pick, pickaxe, or chisel used for working stone and hard earth, also used by a carpenter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also be applied to a tool like a مِعْوَل.
